title: REDACTED Font Texturepack
description: Based on the funny joke lately everything is redacted
body:
**This is a joke pack!**

This pack is a fun pack i made because i was bored.

**This pack makes everything if not nearly everything unreadable or should i say **_redacted_** so be careful  where you use this!**

This pack just replaces the default font with black lines making everything unreadable. :)
